analysis.title: Array Technologies Inc. (ARRY): Guidance lowered but order book achieves record as proposed business combination would expand opportunity set
key_insights: ARRY 3Q26 revenue was $330mn, down 26% yoy and 3% qoq, above GSe/FactSet consensus of $322mn/$323mn. Adj. EBITDA of ~$32mn and adj. EPS of $0.06 missed GSe/consensus of $38mn/$39mn and $0.09/$0.10.

Adj. gross margin was 22.8%, down ~525bps yoy and ~800bps qoq, including a ~330bp charge tied to a long-dated 45X rebate reserve with a supplier. YTD adj. gross margin remains modestly above the prior year.

Order book rose to $2.6bn from $2.5bn, the fourth consecutive quarter of record order book and the fifth consecutive quarter with bookings above $400mn. Nearly 60% of the order book is new products (OmniTrack, SkyLink, SmarTrack, Hail XP, APA), up from 50% last quarter.
Affordable Wire Management (AWM) contributed $9mn of revenue in its first month and was accretive to margins and earnings.
4Q26 revenue guidance is $445mn-$505mn, below GSe/consensus of $539mn/$547mn, because projects are pushed into 1H27. FY26 revenue guidance was cut to $1.34bn-$1.40bn from $1.4bn-$1.5bn.
FY26 adj. EBITDA guidance is now $190mn-$210mn (prior $210mn-$230mn) and adj. EPS guidance is $0.57-$0.69 (prior $0.68-$0.75). Adj. gross margin guidance is 27% (prior 27%-28%).

Proposed all-stock combination with SHLS: each SHLS share converts into 1.6931 ARRY shares, with SHLS/ARRY holders owning ~65%/~35% of the combined company. ARRY stays the surviving legal entity and keeps its existing debt financing.
Management targets ~$35mn of incremental adj. EBITDA synergies in year one, rising to >$100mn annually by year three. Preliminary 2027 combined revenue/adj. EBITDA is $2.2bn-$2.4bn/$410mn-$480mn.

Only ~20% of historical project volume used products from both companies. Management estimates a ~$2.5bn cross-sell opportunity and an ~$1.8bn annual US SBOS/EBOS profit pool, with further room in international markets, BESS and data centers.

The company plans to redeem $317.5mn of preferred stock. Pro forma net leverage is expected at ~2.6X in 2026 and <2.0X in 2027. Close is expected in 1Q27, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.
GS cut 2026E-2028E adj. EPS by 14%/7%/3% to $0.65/$0.79/$0.95 on weaker margin execution. 2026E revenue falls 4% to $1,372.5mn and adj. EBITDA falls 8% to $200.9mn.
GS is NOT RATED on ARRY with no price target, because Goldman Sachs is acting as financial advisor on the announced strategic transaction.
earnings_insights: ARRY 3Q26 (reported 11/4/2026): revenue $330mn vs GSe $322mn / FactSet consensus $323mn (beat). Adj. EBITDA ~$32mn vs GSe $38mn / consensus $39mn (miss). Adj. (non-GAAP) EPS $0.06 vs GSe $0.09 / consensus $0.10 (miss). GAAP diluted EPS was -$0.05.
Adj. gross margin 22.8% in 3Q26, including a ~330bp charge for a long-dated 45X rebate reserve with a supplier.

4Q26 revenue guidance $445mn-$505mn vs GSe/consensus $539mn/$547mn. FY26 guidance: revenue $1.34bn-$1.40bn (prior $1.4bn-$1.5bn), adj. gross margin 27% (prior 27%-28%), adj. EBITDA $190mn-$210mn (prior $210mn-$230mn), adj. EPS $0.57-$0.69 (prior $0.68-$0.75).

GS revised 2026E/2027E/2028E non-GAAP diluted EPS to $0.65/$0.79/$0.95 from $0.75/$0.85/$0.97, and adj. EBITDA to $200.9mn/$229.9mn/$267.9mn from $219.4mn/$244.8mn/$276.1mn. These are GS estimates, not reported figures.
risk_factors: Project pushouts into 1H27 are lowering 4Q26 and FY26 revenue.
Margin execution is weaker than GS expected, including the 45X rebate reserve charge.
The SHLS combination needs shareholder and regulatory approvals and is expected to close in 1Q27.
Pro forma net leverage is ~2.6X in 2026 and <2.0X in 2027 per management, with $317.5mn of preferred stock to be redeemed.
